C0453.title: Man Sentenced to 5 Years for Impersonating Bank Staff and Cashing Out ¥75,000 with Stolen Credit Card
C0453.summary: In April 2018, a man surnamed Chen from Ding’an, Hainan, exploited his role delivering credit cards to impersonate a bank employee, tricked the cardholder into revealing a verification code, activated the card, and then used a POS terminal to fraudulently cash out ¥75,000 to repay his own loans.
